name: Nephisim
overview: Nephisim was a male member of the tribe of Levi who served as a temple servant. His role is specifically noted in the context of the post-exilic community, highlighting his participation in the religious functions centered around the temple. There are no additional personal notes recorded about him.
namesAndTitles: The individual is known by the name Nephisim, with an alternate form Nephushesim appearing in related texts. Neither name has a recorded meaning in the given data, and both are proper names without divine attribution.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture identifies Nephisim as a descendant of Levi, indicating his Levitical heritage. Beyond this tribal connection, no further family relationships are documented in the provided information.
scriptureSignificance: Nephisim's significance lies in his service as a temple servant within the Levitical tribe during the period of Israel's restoration. His mention underscores the continuity of Levitical duties in the worship and maintenance of the temple. Though not prominent in narrative events, his role reflects the faithful preservation of God's worship practices after the exile.
